subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Matrix plugin wrapper around matrix-js-sdk's private Rust crypto `preprocessToDeviceMessages` hook for this malformed Element SAS accept case?
rationale: The code path appears to be the narrow pre-Rust boundary, but private dependency hooks and E2EE verification preprocessing are merge risks that green CI does not settle.

options.title: Accept With Live Proof
options.body: After redacted live Element/Synapse proof from this branch, merge the focused wrapper and treat matrix-js-sdk upgrades as a required recheck point.

options.title: Require Upstream Or Public Seam
options.body: Do not merge the private hook and instead wait for a matrix-js-sdk or Element fix, or a public SDK preprocessing extension point.

options.title: Override Proof Gap
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the reporter's local hotfix evidence as enough and own the missing branch-level live proof risk.

recommendation.title: Accept With Live Proof
recommendation.body: After redacted live Element/Synapse proof from this branch, merge the focused wrapper and treat matrix-js-sdk upgrades as a required recheck point.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest Matrix E2EE and crypto-facade feature-history signal in the central verification files.
